metaDescription: Order custom 24 oz magnets for your business. Perfect for promotions and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom 24 oz magnets are a unique promotional choice for businesses looking to combine functionality with brand visibility. Unlike standard fridge magnets, these heavier-duty options can hold papers, photos, or small tools on metal surfaces, making them ideal for offices, warehouses, or schools. Their substantial weight ensures they stay put, and they can be printed with your logo using full-color offset or screen printing. Perfect for safety managers or HR directors distributing branded safety reminders or wellness materials.
